escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark hall at night): he stands on the RIGHT third of the frame, his face at about 72 % of the frame width, framed from the waist up, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. Behind him, far in the dark, thousands of tiny glowing particles drift in disorder, scattered at every angle. His right hand is raised open at shoulder height on the camera-left side of his body, his elbow at about 68 % and his open hand at about 63 % of the frame width, at chest height, never further left than 58 % of the frame width. As the particles pass that hand they snap into ORDER: they become a clean three-dimensional lattice of light — stacked horizontal layers joined by thin vertical links, like the floors and columns of a building made of light — that grows from that hand back and up into the depth behind him, layer after layer, with room to keep growing, and never crosses into the left 52 % of the frame. The ordered lattice is cool azure blue (#0375DB) and cool white, the light of Efeonce; only a few small nodes of the lattice glow magenta-pink (#E86BD0) as a sparse accent, never more than one in twenty. The disordered particles behind are dim, faint and cool blue. His head stays almost frontal and his eyes turn toward the empty dark left of the frame, where the text will sit, with a calm, assured closed-mouth half-smile. The light of the lattice paints his face, hand and jacket. Thin haze catches the light. The LEFT 52% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no lattice, no particles, no objects. Rich contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand.
